name: Generate Video
description: Makes a video clip from a prompt on a video model, optionally starting from a first frame.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.label: Negative prompt
inputs.description: What the clip should not show. Models that take none ignore it.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: First frame
inputs.description: The clip starts from this picture. Fitted to the size by covering it and cutting the middle.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.label: Length (seconds)
inputs.description: The model rounds it to a length it can make; the clip's real length is an output.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Width
inputs.description: Unset: the first frame's shape at about 0.4 megapixel, else the model's default.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.description: Unset: the first frame's shape at about 0.4 megapixel, else the model's default.

inputs.name: fps
inputs.label: Frames per second
inputs.description: Unset: the model's default, else 24. Some models make one rate only.
